about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: James R. Baird

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FOUNDATIONAL PRINCIPLES EXEMPLIFIED BY THE HOOSIER STATE
statements.title: FOUNDATIONAL PRINCIPLES EXEMPLIFIED BY THE HOOSIER STATE
sentences: It is this unique spirit that led Indiana to produce three Presidents, six Vice Presidents, and three Supreme Court Justices, earning our reputation as the birthplace of national leadership.
I am a lifelong farmer who studied animal science, so I know firsthand that agriculture is the heartbeat of our State and our national economy.

While I will always be loyal to the Boilermakers, I must congratulate our neighbors in Bloomington, Indiana, the Indiana University football team, who also recently had a perfect 16-0 season, bringing a national championship to the Hoosier State.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING THAT SECTION 11 OF HOUSE RESOLUTION 1224 SHALL HAVE NO FORCE OR EFFECT
statements.title: PROVIDING THAT SECTION 11 OF HOUSE RESOLUTION 1224 SHALL HAVE NO FORCE OR EFFECT
sentences: This is an American-made fuel that reduces dependence on foreign energy while supporting domestic manufacturing and agriculture at the same time.

Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the rule and the underlying legislation for H.R. 1346, the Nationwide Consumer and Fuel Retailer Choice Act, which would finally allow the year-round sale of E15 fuel nationwide.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this rule and this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 7567, FARM, FOOD, AND NATIONAL SECURITY ACT OF 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2616, PARENTAL RIGHTS OVER THE EDUCATIO
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 7567, FARM, FOOD, AND NATIONAL SECURITY ACT OF 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2616, PARENTAL RIGHTS OVER THE EDUCATION AND CARE OF THEIR KIDS ACT...
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise in strong support of the Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026.
Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues on both sides to support this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PAY OUR HOMELAND DEFENDERS ACT
statements.title: PAY OUR HOMELAND DEFENDERS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the extraordinary men and women of the Department of Homeland Security.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to rise above partisanship and prove that the security of the United States will always come first.
I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING MEDICAID
statements.title: PROTECTING MEDICAID
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to highlight how the One Big Beautiful Bill Act will strengthen and protect Medicaid for those who need it the most.
Contrary to the misinformation spreading, there are roughly 1.4 million illegal immigrants who are receiving Medicaid, crowding out benefits meant for American citizens.

This will help preserve Medicaid for the most vulnerable populations who rely on it: pregnant mothers, children, seniors, and individuals with disabilities and low- income families. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BENEFITS OF ONE BIG, BEAUTIFUL BILL
statements.title: BENEFITS OF ONE BIG, BEAUTIFUL BILL
sentences: This legislation also saves 2 million family farms, including over 6,800 family farms in my district, from facing a death tax increase.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE OFFICE OF ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND RENEWABLE ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY RELATING TO "ENERGY CONS
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE OFFICE OF ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND RENEWABLE ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY RELATING TO "ENERGY CONSERVATION PROGRAM: ENERGY...
sentences: Once again, the left's pro-Big Government, Green New Deal agenda harms the little guy.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.J. Res. 75.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this underlying bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MATHEMATICAL AND STATISTICAL MODELING EDUCATION ACT
statements.title: MATHEMATICAL AND STATISTICAL MODELING EDUCATION ACT
sentences: As we look at reining in the out-of-control government spending and bureaucracy, we must work with the resources we already have.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DOE AND NSF INTERAGENCY RESEARCH ACT
statements.title: DOE AND NSF INTERAGENCY RESEARCH ACT
sentences: Combined, these agencies tackle the modern challenges of physics, quantum information sciences, Artificial Intelligence, and beyond.

Operating in a silo is never the best practice when it comes to conducting scientific research, especially as our country looks to maximize the use of Americans' taxpayer dollars AND bolster our science and technology sectors to combat the growing threat of the Chinese Communist Party.

As we face increased competition from Communist China, we must ensure WE lead the world in research and development, including in areas like Artificial Intelligence, so that our country--not Communist China-- continues to set the rules of the road.

Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Department of Energy and National Science Foundation Interagency Research Act, and I thank Congresswoman Haley Stevens for working with me on this bipartisan bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PUTTING AMERICA FIRST BORDER SECURITY POLICIES BACK IN PLACE
statements.title: PUTTING AMERICA FIRST BORDER SECURITY POLICIES BACK IN PLACE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, under the Biden administration, our borders were wide open with record numbers of illegal immigrants and deadly drugs flooding across our border.
Under President Biden, every single State became a border State including Indiana.
I thank law enforcement officers for their hard work to find and arrest this criminal.
Under President Trump, we have swiftly returned to commonsense border policies, and illegal border crossings have plunged to a record low.
In January 2025, there were 61,465 illegal border crossings, down from 176,000 in January '24.
Just last month, illegal crossings at our southern border plummeted to the lowest level on record.
President Trump has sent a message loud and clear that the border is closed, and his strong border security policies are working.
House Republicans are working with the President to implement his agenda to secure our border and keep Americans safe.
